info.description: API for publishing and browsing merged OpenAPI/OpenRPC documentation.
info.title: docs-hub API

post.description:
Replaces the installed license.json with the uploaded one. Rejected (400) if it is
malformed, was issued for a different device_id than this installation's own, or is
already expired.

get.description:
Returns whether the automatic license renewal is enabled, whether a token is saved (the token itself
is never returned) and the outcome of the last check against the license server.
get.summary: Auto renew settings

put.description:
Saves the renewal token and the switch. While enabled, the installation asks the license server
for a newer license every hour and installs it, keeping the replaced license.json under a new name.

parameters.description: Settings; an omitted token keeps the saved one
parameters.name: body

400.description: Invalid body, or enabling without a token

get.description:
Returns every MCP token with its settings and allowed services, ordered by name. The secret itself
is never included, only whether one exists.
get.summary: List MCP tokens

post.description:
Adds a token with the given name and settings and a freshly generated secret. The raw secret is
returned exactly once; only its salted hash is stored. Names are unique, case-insensitive.

get.description: Returns one token with its settings and allowed services (never the secret).
get.summary: Get an MCP token

put.description:
Replaces the name and every setting of the token, including its allowed services. The secret is not
changed (see POST .../token).

delete.description: Removes the token record completely; its secret stops working at once.

put.description: A deactivated token is rejected by the MCP endpoint; its settings are kept.
put.summary: Activate or deactivate an MCP token

post.description:
Generates a brand-new secret, invalidating the previous one, and returns the raw value exactly once.
Only its salted hash is stored; it cannot be retrieved again afterward.
post.summary: Replace the secret of an MCP token

get.description:
Returns every configured channel (webhook, email, telegram, slack) without secrets - only
which secrets are set - with the number of rules using it and its latest delivery.
get.summary: List notification channels

put.description:
Replaces the channel's settings. A secret that is missing or empty in the request keeps its
stored value; clear_secrets removes secrets. The channel type cannot change.

delete.description: Deletes the channel together with its rules and delivery history.

post.description:
Sends a test message through the saved channel right away. The response says whether it worked;
the error text never contains secrets.

get.description: The newest deliveries with their status, attempts and last error.
get.summary: List notification deliveries
Get license-expiry notification rules

put.description: One rule per channel; thresholds is any subset of 7d, 3d, 2d, 1d. The license is checked once a day.

get.summary: Get new-version notification rules

put.description:
One rule per channel: which services (or all), whether only breaking changes notify and the
language of the messages (a UI language code; empty means the default language).

get.summary: Get the shared SMTP settings

put.description: Used by every email channel. An empty password keeps the stored one.

post.description: Runs a merge of the current service specifications and creates a new snapshot.
post.summary: Force a rebuild of the merged document

get.description: Returns every group in display order, each with its services in the group's own order.
get.summary: List service groups

post.description: Adds a group at the end of the list. The name must be unique (case-insensitive).

put.description: Sets the display order of the groups; the request must list every group id exactly once.

parameters.description: Group ids in the new order
parameters.name: request

put.description:
Renames the group and, when service_slugs is given, replaces its services and their order. For
the default group the list can only reorder: every service stays in it.

delete.description: Removes the group; its services stay in the default group. The default group cannot be deleted.

get.summary: List services

post.description: Creates the service and returns its raw service token once; only a hash of it is stored.

403.description: Admin role required or service limit of the license reached

post.description: Generates a new service token, stores only its hash and returns the raw token once.

get.summary: List SSO providers

post.summary: Check an SSO issuer's discovery document

get.summary: Preview the effect of deleting an SSO provider
Get global SSO settings

get.description:
Returns teams matching the optional name/member_login/service_name filters, sorted
by name case-insensitively.
get.summary: List teams

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on team name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on any member login
parameters.name: member_login

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on any referenced service's name
parameters.name: service_name

post.description:
Creates a team of editor/reader members and the services they may access through
it. Members must already exist and hold the editor or reader role - admins cannot
be added, since they are exempt from team scoping entirely. Service slugs must
refer to existing services.

put.description: Fully replaces a team's name, members, and services.

delete.description: Deletes a team by id. Not an error if it is already absent.

get.description: All query parameters are optional and combine with AND when given together.
get.summary: List users

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of a team name
parameters.name: team

parameters.description: User to create; password is required
parameters.name: body

403.description: Admin role required or user limit of the license reached

parameters.description: New user data; an empty password keeps the current one
parameters.name: body

post.description: Deletes the secret and backup codes but keeps 2FA enabled; the user pairs a new authenticator at the next login.
post.summary: Reset the two-factor authenticator of a user

409.description: Two-factor authentication is not enabled for the user

get.summary: List the current user's sign-in methods

delete.summary: Unlink an SSO provider from the current user

post.summary: Start linking an SSO provider to the current user
Set or change the current user's password

get.summary: List SSO providers for the login page

get.description:
Pages that can be placed at the start or the end of an export, newest edit first. q filters by name
or text (case-insensitive substring).
get.summary: List the caller's export pages

parameters.description: Name or text to search for
parameters.name: q

post.description: Stores a new page (elements may be text only - images are uploaded to the stored page afterwards).

get.summary: Get an export page

put.description: updated_at must be the value of the last read, otherwise the request is rejected with 409.

delete.description: Deletes the page and its image files. Exports that already used it keep their own snapshot.

post.description: Copies the page with its images; the copy's name gets a " (copy)" suffix.

multipart/form-data with several files in the field "files". The type is decided from the content
(PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP - converted to PNG - and SVG - sanitized), not from the name. A file that is
refused does not stop the others; every file gets its own result. For an SVG the browser can send
a PNG copy as the field "raster_<file name>", used by the formats that cannot draw SVG.
post.summary: Upload images to an export page

get.description:
Served with its verified type, nosniff and a policy that forbids scripts, so an SVG cannot run
anything when opened directly. raster=1 returns the PNG copy of an SVG.
get.summary: Get an image of an export page

parameters.description: 1 for the PNG copy of an SVG
parameters.name: raster

delete.description: An element that still refers to the image makes the next save of the page fail until it is removed.
delete.summary: Delete an image of an export page

get.description:
Returns the export history of the current user only, newest first. Optional filters
(all combined with AND): name (case-insensitive substring), created_from (inclusive)
and created_before (exclusive) as RFC 3339 timestamps, status, format, language.
get.summary: List the caller's exports

post.description:
Validates the export parameters (name, format, services with their selected tags and
endpoints, environment, overlay flag), creates an in-progress export owned by the
caller and starts generating the file in the background. Every service must be
accessible to the caller and every environment visible to them the same way as in
Try-It.

Removes the listed exports of the current user from the database and their files from
disk. All-or-nothing: 404 if any id is unknown or belongs to someone else, 409 if any
export is still in progress.

get.description:
Returns one of the caller's exports including the saved parameters (used to repeat an
export and to poll progress). Another user's export is reported as not found.
get.summary: Get an export with its parameters

get.description:
Streams the generated file. Available for successful exports and for failed ones that
still produced a (partial) file; 409 while the export is in progress, 404 when there
is no file.
get.summary: Download an export file

get.description:
The pages an export was made with (the snapshot taken when it started): both lists in output order and,
for every page, whether the library still has it unchanged (current), changed since (changed) or no
longer has it (deleted). Used to repeat an export.
get.summary: Pages of an export

post.description:
Creates a library page from the copy kept with the export (used when the library page was deleted or
changed). The name is "<page> (from export <export>)". Restoring the same page again returns the
page restored before (200 instead of 201).
post.summary: Restore a page of an export

get.summary: List the current user's favorite tags, endpoints, folders and pages

get.description:
Returns the web UI translations from data/translations/{lang}.yaml, falling back to the
default language and the built-in English set. The endpoint is public.
get.summary: Get UI translations

get.description:
Returns the full interaction (request and every response) to any authenticated user
who can read the owning service - the unguessable id is what a shared link carries.
get.summary: Get a saved interaction by id

delete.description: Only the owner (or an admin) may delete it; the link stops working.

get.summary: Export a saved interaction as PDF

get.description:
Returns this installation's device ID and the currently installed license's
validity, dates, and (if invalid) a machine-readable reason - reachable without
authentication. can_admin reports whether the caller's own session (if any) may
use POST /api/v1/admin/license to install a new one.
get.summary: Current license status

get.description:
Returns that service's own current merged document (task 101 - one file per
service, no longer a single document combining every service). Works uniformly for
an OpenAPI or an OpenRPC service - the shape of the returned document simply
follows whichever that service's own SpecFormat is.
get.summary: Get one service's merged specification

parameters.description: Explicit version to view (task 179); defaults to pin, then current
parameters.name: version

get.description:
Returns every service's own endpoints/tag groups the current session may see,
scoped down to the session's team-visible services for a non-admin role.
"service"/"version" together (task 179) let the caller pin the explicit branch/
version a single named service is resolved from - as opposed to every other
service in the same response, which keeps resolving from that session's own
personal pin or the current version as usual; passing "version" without "service",
or naming a service other than the one this session is currently viewing, has no
effect on any other service's own resolution.
get.summary: Left navigation tree for every visible service

parameters.description: Scope the explicit version below to this one service's slug (task 179)
parameters.name: service

get.description: Returns overlays moved to data/overlays/_orphaned/ after a rebuild.
get.summary: List orphaned Markdown overlays

delete.description: Deletes the Markdown file and metadata from data/overlays/_orphaned/.

get.summary: Current user's profile

get.description:
Returns the domains the documentation is published on, sorted by name. Available to admins and
editors (the domain picker of the publishing section).
get.summary: List publishing domains

post.description:
Adds a domain with an optional style. The value is normalized (lower case, scheme, path and default
port removed). Admin only; limited by the license (max_publish_domains).

put.description: Replaces the domain name and its style. Admin only.

delete.description: Deletes the domain together with the versions published on it. Admin only.

get.description:
Returns the versions in their display order, with the build status and whether the caller may change
each one. Admins and editors.
get.summary: List the published versions of a domain

post.description:
Saves the selection (services, endpoints, text pages, whether overlays are applied and whether examples
are published) and builds the snapshot in the background; the version is "building" until it is ready.
Every service must be accessible to the caller. Limited by the license (max_publish_versions_per_domain).
post.summary: Publish a new version on a domain

get.summary: List saved palettes

post.description: Saves a set of tokens for reuse. Colors must be #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa; nothing else is accepted.

put.description: Replaces the name and tokens. Styles that refer to the palette follow the change.

delete.description: Refused with 409 while a style refers to the palette; the message lists those styles.

get.description: Returns the built-in, ready-made color palettes and styles with every token set.
get.summary: List style presets

get.description: Returns the styles of the published sites, sorted by name (admin only).
get.summary: List styles

post.description: Creates a style from a preset or a saved palette plus overrides, and the site texts and languages.

get.summary: Get a style

delete.description: Refused with 409 while a domain uses the style; the message lists those domains.

get.description: Served with its verified type, nosniff and a policy that forbids scripts (admin preview).
get.summary: Get a picture of a style

put.description:
Stores the top logo (logo_top), the bottom logo (logo_bottom) or the favicon (favicon). PNG, JPEG and
WebP are accepted, ICO only for the favicon, at most 1 MB; the type is verified from the content. SVG is
not accepted. The picture replaces the previous one.
put.summary: Upload a picture of a style

delete.summary: Delete a picture of a style

post.description:
Merges the default preset, the chosen preset or palette and the overrides, and reports colour pairs
whose contrast is below WCAG AA (advice only).

get.description: Returns the version, the parameters of each service and what the snapshot holds of it.
get.summary: Get a published version with its services

put.description:
The name is the only parameter of a version that can be edited; to change the services, remove a
service from the version and add it again.

delete.description: Deletes the version and its snapshot. An editor needs access to every service of the version.

put.description: A hidden version is not served by the public API (except with a preview token).
put.summary: Hide or show a published version

post.description: Swaps the version with its neighbour in the order of the domain; moving past either end does nothing.
post.summary: Move a published version up or down

post.description:
Returns a signed token, valid for one hour and bound to this version, that lets the public site show
the version even while it is hidden (the site sends it in the X-Preview-Token header).
post.summary: Get a preview token of a version

post.description:
Builds the files of the new service in the background and adds them to the version; the other services
are not touched. The service must be accessible to the caller.
post.summary: Add a service to a published version

put.description:
The order is the order of the services in the menu of the site. The list must contain every service of
the version exactly once.
put.summary: Change the order of the services of a published version

delete.description: Removes the files of the service from the version. The last service cannot be removed.
delete.summary: Remove a service from a published version

get.description:
Searches by substring words among the services and endpoints from /api/v1/navigation.
Queries shorter than search_min_length return an empty list.
get.summary: Server-side search across services and endpoints

get.description:
Returns one AsyncAPI operation (action, channel with its parameters, messages with their headers
and payload, reply) from the merged document, together with the servers and only those schemas
the operation references via $ref, transitively - without the full document.
get.summary: Single AsyncAPI operation schema without the full merged document

parameters.description: Operation id in the merged document, including the namespace prefix
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Explicit version to view (task 179); defaults to pin, then current
parameters.name: version

get.description:
Generates a fake example ({"headers": ..., "payload": ...}) of one message from its JSON Schema,
resolving $ref transitively the same way GET .../asyncapi-operation-schema does. Messages written in
another schema format (Avro, protobuf) have no generated example (400).
get.summary: Generate an example of one message of an AsyncAPI operation

parameters.description: Operation id in the merged document, including the namespace prefix
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Explicit version to view (task 179); defaults to pin, then current
parameters.name: version

get.description:
Returns the parameters/responses/requestBody of a single operation from the
merged document, together with only those components (schemas, parameters,
responses, etc.) that the operation references via $ref, transitively - without
the full document.
get.summary: Single operation schema without the full merged document

parameters.description: Operation path in the merged document, including the service prefix
parameters.name: path

parameters.description: Explicit version to view (task 179); defaults to pin, then current
parameters.name: version

get.description:
Generates a fake example value for a scoped operation's application/json request
body, resolving $ref/allOf transitively the same way GET .../endpoint-schema does.
String fields become "<field name>_<random number>", numeric fields a random
number of the matching type, enum fields a random allowed value. Only
application/json request bodies are supported for now.
get.summary: Generate an example request body for one operation

parameters.description: Operation path in the merged document, including the service prefix
parameters.name: path

parameters.description: Explicit version to view (task 179); defaults to pin, then current
parameters.name: version

get.description:
Generates a fake example value for a scoped operation's primary success response
(the lowest declared 2xx status code) application/json body, resolving $ref/allOf
transitively the same way GET .../endpoint-schema does.
get.summary: Generate an example response body for one operation

parameters.description: Operation path in the merged document, including the service prefix
parameters.name: path

parameters.description: Explicit version to view (task 179); defaults to pin, then current
parameters.name: version

get.description:
Returns the environments (name, base URL, HTTP headers) configured for the
service, sorted by name case-insensitively - every public one, the caller's own
private ones, and (admin only) every other private one too (task 196). Use
GET .../environments/tryit-options instead to populate a Try-It environment picker,
which never includes another user's private environment even for an admin.
get.summary: List service environments

post.description:
Adds a new environment (name, base URL, HTTP headers, connect and response
timeouts in seconds) for the service. The base URL is validated the same way as
the Try-It proxy target: http/https scheme, host present, no userinfo/query/fragment.
Both timeouts must be a positive number of seconds not exceeding 300. Any
authenticated role (reader/editor/admin) with access to the service may create one
(task 196) - the creating session becomes its owner, the only one (besides an
admin) who can later edit or delete it.

get.description:
Like GET .../environments, but applies Try-It's own visibility rule (task 196):
public environments and the caller's own private ones - never another user's
private environment, even for an admin (who does see it on the service page via
the plain GET .../environments route, just not here).
get.summary: List environments usable as a Try-It target

put.description:
Fully replaces the name, base URL, headers, timeouts, and public/private flag of an
existing environment. Only its own creator or an admin may do this (task 196) -
anyone else gets 403, even for a public environment they can otherwise view.

delete.description:
Deletes the environment by id. Only its own creator or an admin may do this (task
196) - anyone else gets 403. Not an error if it is already absent.

put.description:
Idempotent. kind is "tag" (item_id is the tag name), "endpoint" (item_id is the endpoint id
from /api/v1/navigation), "folder" or "page" (item_id is the key of that node in the navigation tree).
put.summary: Add a tag, endpoint, folder or page to the current user's favorites

delete.description: Idempotent; see PUT for the meaning of kind and item_id.
delete.summary: Remove a tag, endpoint, folder or page from the current user's favorites

parameters.description: Tag name, endpoint id, folder or page key
parameters.name: item_id

get.description:
Returns the args/type/deprecated/description of a single GraphQL field from the
merged document, together with every type transitively reachable from its own
return type and argument types - without the full document.
get.summary: Single GraphQL field schema without the full merged document

parameters.description: Explicit version to view (task 179); defaults to pin, then current
parameters.name: version

get.summary: List the current user's saved interactions for one endpoint

post.description:
Saves one executed Try-It request with all of its responses under a user-chosen name.
The request and responses are stored as files, only metadata goes to the database.
With mask_sensitive the values of sensitive headers (Authorization, Cookie, ...)
are replaced with *** on the server before anything is written.
Renders the posted interaction without saving anything. Masking behaves as on save.
post.summary: Export the current Try-It state as PDF

get.description:
Every label of every endpoint and text page of the service, ordered by label. kind is "endpoint"
(item_id is the endpoint id from /api/v1/navigation) or "page" (item_id is the page id). The tags of
the specification are not listed: they come with the navigation.
get.summary: List the manual labels of a service

put.description:
Idempotent. A label is a text of letters, digits, spaces, "-" and "_" (at most 40 characters,
stored in lower case, spaces trimmed and collapsed); an item has at most 20 labels (409 beyond that).
put.summary: Put a label on an endpoint or a text page

delete.description: Idempotent.
delete.summary: Take a label off an endpoint or a text page

get.description:
Returns the mode ("all": every documented endpoint, the default; "selected": only the ticked ones) and
the ids of the ticked tree nodes ("endpoint:<id>", "tag:<name>", "folder:<id>"). Administrators only.
get.summary: Get the endpoints a service opens to the MCP Try-It tools

put.description:
Replaces the mode and the ticked nodes. updated_at must be the value of the last read, otherwise the
request is rejected with 409. Administrators only.
put.summary: Save the endpoints a service opens to the MCP Try-It tools

409.description: The choice was changed after it was read

get.description:
Returns the history of one service's own merged document snapshots, newest first
(task 101 - snapshot history is per-service, not a single history shared by every
service).
get.summary: List one service's merged document snapshots

get.description:
Returns the content of one historical merged document snapshot belonging to one
service.
get.summary: Get one service's merged document snapshot

post.description: Makes the selected snapshot that service's own current merged document.
post.summary: Roll back one service's merged document to a snapshot

get.description:
Returns the saved tree (folders, tags, endpoints and text pages; a tag is a folder made from a tag of the specification)
with its last update time and the deepest allowed level, or exists=false when none was saved.
The tree is per service and applies to every specification version.
get.summary: Get the saved tree of a service

403.description: Insufficient role, or service outside the session's teams

put.description:
Replaces the tree. Tags and endpoints the submitted tree does not mention (for example
tags that only older versions have) are kept. A folder without a key gets one. updated_at must
be the value of the last read, otherwise the request is rejected with 409.
put.summary: Save the tree of a service

403.description: Insufficient role, or service outside the session's teams

409.description: The tree was changed after it was read

delete.description:
Removes the saved tree, so tags are sorted by name again, endpoints keep the order of
the specification and folders are gone.
delete.summary: Reset the tree of a service

403.description: Insufficient role, or service outside the session's teams

get.description:
Reads service.md, op_{operationId}.md, route_{METHOD}_{base64url(path)}.md or tag_{tag}.md
under data/overlays/{slug}/. An absent overlay is not an error.
get.summary: Read a Markdown description overlay

parameters.description: HTTP method (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Endpoint path (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: path

put.description:
Saves service.md, op_{operationId}.md, route_{METHOD}_{base64url(path)}.md,
or tag_{tag}.md. Files live under data/overlays/{slug}/; the merged document is
rebuilt after saving.

delete.description:
Deletes service.md, op_{operationId}.md, route_{METHOD}_{base64url(path)}.md,
or tag_{tag}.md under data/overlays/{slug}/ and rebuilds the merged document. Not
an error if the overlay is already absent - the response contains existed=false.

parameters.description: HTTP method (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Endpoint path (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: path

get.description:
Returns overlay_versions rows for one overlay file, newest first, each marked
is_current. The Markdown body of each version is not included - see
GetOverlayVersion.
get.summary: List an overlay's saved versions

parameters.description: HTTP method (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Endpoint path (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: path

get.description:
Returns one saved version's metadata and its own Markdown body (not the overlay's
current content).
get.summary: Read one overlay version

delete.description:
Permanently deletes one historical version's row and its snapshot file. Refuses
(409) to delete the version currently serving the overlay file.

get.description: The pages in creation order, without their text. Open to everyone who can see the service.
get.summary: List the text pages of a service

post.description: The page appears at the end of the first level of the service tree until it is moved.

get.description:
The page with its Markdown text and the list of its pictures. A picture is linked from the text as
/api/v1/services/{slug}/pages/{id}/images/{imageId}.
get.summary: Get a text page of a service

put.description:
Replaces the title and the text. updated_at must be the value of the last read, otherwise the
request is rejected with 409. Pictures older than an hour that the text no longer links to are removed.

409.description: The page was changed after it was read

delete.description: Removes the page and its pictures.

post.description:
One file in the multipart field "file" (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG, at most 5 MB). The same
content uploaded twice returns the first record with duplicate=true. Link the picture from the
text with the returned url.
post.summary: Upload a picture of a text page

get.description:
Served with its verified type, nosniff and a policy that forbids scripts, so an SVG cannot run
anything when opened directly. Open to everyone who can see the service.
get.summary: Get a picture of a text page

delete.summary: Delete a picture of a text page

get.description:
Every save of the page, newest first (the first one is the current text), with the time and the
login of the person who made it. The text of a version comes from the single-version endpoint.
get.summary: List the history of a text page
Get one saved version of a text page

get.description:
Returns the current Markdown overlay of every parameter of one operation (an endpoint) plus the
file revision. All parameter overlays of an operation live in one JSON file with their history.
get.summary: List the parameter overlays of an operation

parameters.description: HTTP method (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Endpoint path (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: path

put.description:
Replaces the description of a parameter (or of a nested property, anchors like query:status,
query:filter.status, body:application/json.name). An empty markdown deletes the overlay with its
history. revision is the value of the last read; a mismatch is rejected with 409.
put.summary: Save or delete the overlay of one parameter

get.description: The current version first, then older ones (up to 50), each with its Markdown.
get.summary: List the versions of a parameter overlay

parameters.description: HTTP method (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Endpoint path (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: path

delete.description: The current version cannot be deleted. revision (optional) guards against a concurrent change.
delete.summary: Delete an older version of a parameter overlay

parameters.description: HTTP method (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Endpoint path (if operation_id is not set)
parameters.name: path

post.description:
The text of the chosen version becomes the new current version; the previous current version
moves to the history and the restored one stays there too.
post.summary: Restore an older version of a parameter overlay

get.description:
Returns the params/result/errors of a single OpenRPC method from the merged RPC
document, together with only those components (schemas, contentDescriptors, etc.)
that the method references via $ref, transitively - without the full document.
get.summary: Single OpenRPC method schema without the full merged document

parameters.description: Method name in the merged RPC document, including the namespace prefix
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Explicit version to view (task 179); defaults to pin, then current
parameters.name: version

get.description:
Generates a fake example value for each of a scoped OpenRPC method's params,
keyed by param name, resolving $ref/allOf transitively the same way
GET .../rpc-method-schema does.
get.summary: Generate an example params object for one OpenRPC method

belongs to. Absent on update leaves the groups as they are; on create it means only the default group.

SpecFormat, which buildService receives separately) - an update that omits it resets it to
domain.DefaultMainBranch, the same way omitting Description already resets that to "".

never a raw possibly-empty field - a service response always shows a concrete branch name,

even one this service is only implicitly using because it was never set explicitly.

belongs to. Absent on update leaves the groups as they are; on create it means only the default group.

MainBranch is a full-replace field like Description (not a partial-update one like
SpecFormat, which buildService receives separately) - an update that omits it resets it to
domain.DefaultMainBranch, the same way omitting Description already resets that to "".

team_ids.description:
TeamIDs is the set of team ids this user should belong to after this request - ignored (team
membership is cleared instead, see setUserTeams) when Role is domain.RoleAdmin.

two_factor_enabled.description:
TwoFactorEnabled switches two-factor authentication on or off for the user; omitted leaves
it unchanged (a new user starts with it off). Switching it off also wipes the user's
authenticator secret and backup codes.

has_password.description:
HasPassword is false for an account created through SSO that never set a password; Identities
lists the SSO providers linked to the user (task 223). Together they are the user's sign-in methods.

teams.description:
Teams is the sorted list of team names this user is a member of - always empty for an admin
(admins are exempt from team scoping entirely, see internal/team's package doc comment).

two_factor_enabled.description:
TwoFactorEnabled is the admin-controlled 2FA switch; TwoFactorStatus is "disabled", "pending"
(enabled, the user still has to pair an authenticator at their next login) or "configured".

remember_me.description: RememberMe selects the longer session lifetime (remember_me_timeout) instead of session_timeout.

backup_codes.description: BackupCodes is set only by the confirm step, which is the one time they are ever shown.

status.description:
Status is "ok" (Token is set), "two_factor_setup_required" or "two_factor_required"
(PendingToken is set).

qr_code.description: QRCode is a data: URL with the server-rendered PNG QR code of URI.

breaking.description:
Breaking is set by formats whose compatibility rules are richer than "something was removed" (AsyncAPI, task
273: the direction of a message decides what is breaking); the other formats leave it false and rely on the
rules in Changelog.Breaking.

operation_changes.description: OperationChanges lists what changed in the operation itself: summary, description, deprecation, path (task 295).

operation_id.description:
OperationID is the operation's own operationId (OpenAPI) or method name (OpenRPC), exactly as
written in the un-merged spec - never merge-namespaced. Added so a Modified entry can be
looked up later by an endpoint page (task 104's Change History section) without re-deriving
it from Method+URI, which OpenRPC entries (empty Method/URI, see toEntry) have no other way
to be identified by at all.

parameter_changes.description:
ParameterChanges and ResponseFieldChanges are only ever populated on a Modified entry - an
Added or Removed entry describes a whole operation appearing/disappearing, not a structural
diff within one that still exists in both versions.

detail.description: Detail explains a "changed" change: "string -> integer", "now required", ...

from.description:
From and To carry the full old and new text of a changed operation summary or description, so that a client can
draw a text diff; Detail only has both texts shortened. Nil for every other change. Truncated is set when
either text was cut to maxDiffTextBytes.

in.description:
In is the OpenAPI parameter location ("query", "path", "header", "cookie") - empty for
response/result field changes and for OpenRPC params, which have no such concept.

branch.description:
Branch is the documentation branch this version was published to (task 166), e.g. "main" or
a feature branch name. Versions published before this field existed have it empty - callers
must not read it directly for that reason; treat an empty Branch as the owning service's own
EffectiveMainBranch() instead (internal/versions.Manager's callers apply this fallback, since
the Manager itself has no access to the service registry).

breaking.description:
Breaking is true when this version's Change Log (see ChangelogCounts above) removed an
endpoint entirely, or added/removed a request parameter or response field on one that still
exists (task 104) - see changelog.Changelog.Breaking() for the exact rule. False (the zero
value, omitted from JSON) for the first version of a service and for versions published
before this field existed - not recomputed automatically, only by
versions.Manager.RecalculateChangelogs (the same backfill path ChangelogCounts uses).

changelog_counts.description:
ChangelogCounts is nil when this version has no Change Log - the very first version of a
service (nothing to compare against) or a version published before this field existed.
See internal/changelog for how it and the full Change Log entries are computed and stored.

format_version.description:
FormatVersion is the raw value of the document's own root openrpc/openapi/swagger field
(e.g. "1.2.6" or "3.0.3") - the documentation format's version, not the API's own
info.version (that's SpecVersion above). Versions published before this field existed have
it empty - there is no migration, old .meta.json files simply lack the key.

spec_version.description:
SpecVersion is the spec's own info.version, if any. Versions published before this field
existed have it empty - there is no migration, old .meta.json files simply lack the key.

created_by.description:
CreatedBy is the login of the session that created this environment (task 196) - empty for an
environment auto-created by internal/ingest's syncEnvironmentsFromServers, which runs during
spec publish with no user session at all. Set once at Create time and never changed by Update
(ownership isn't transferable by editing).

is_public.description:
IsPublic marks an environment visible to every session with read access to the service (both
on the service page and in the Try-It dropdown), not just its own creator and admins (task
196). Defaults to false (private) for anything created through the API - the zero value
already gives "private by default" with no extra code.

mcp_enabled.description:
MCPEnabled opens the environment to the Try-It tools of the MCP server (task 329). Only an administrator turns
it on; it needs a public environment, and a change of the target or of the headers by anyone else turns it off
again (see the handler).

skip_tls_verify.description:
SkipTLSVerify disables TLS certificate verification for Try-It requests against this
environment. Named (and zero-valued) so that an environment saved before this field existed
is read back as false - i.e. still verifies certificates, matching its previous behavior with
no migration needed.

sensitive.description:
Sensitive marks a header that carries a secret (a token, a key): the MCP server never shows its value to the
model (task 329). People see it in the UI as before.

is_public.description:
IsPublic (task 196) defaults to false (private) when omitted, matching Environment.IsPublic's
own zero-value default.

mcp_enabled.description:
MCPEnabled (task 329) opens the environment to the MCP server's Try-It tools. Only an administrator can turn
it on or off; the field of anyone else's request is ignored.

description.description:
Description is the removed document introduction (task 251). It is still accepted in a request, so clients
written before the removal keep working, but Create drops it: it is never stored or rendered, and the old
value in a stored export is ignored.

front_pages.description:
FrontPages and BackPages are ids of the caller's export pages (tasks 241-249) placed before and after the
document, in output order. A page may be in both lists; within one list it appears once.

include_contents.description:
IncludeContents switches the contents (table of contents) block on or off; omitted means on
(task 207) - a pointer so an export saved before this setting existed repeats with the block.

language.description:
Language is the translation language of the file's static labels (task 206); the create
handler fills in the default language when it is empty and rejects an unknown one.

front_pages_count.description: FrontPagesCount and BackPagesCount are the sizes of the page lists the export was made with (task 247).

params.description: Params is only populated by Get, not by List (the history table does not need it).

version's branch from the oldest stored one up to the selected one.

environment_id.description: EnvironmentID is empty when the service is exported without an environment.

pages.description:
Pages are the ids of the selected text pages of the service (task 305); a service needs at least one endpoint
or one page.

tags.description:
Tags are the selected tag names. Endpoints are the selected endpoint ids; an endpoint with no
tag is selected by its id alone.

version_id.description:
VersionID is the version of the service to export (task 252); empty means the current version, which is what
exports saved before this field did.

image.description:
Image elements: the id of an image of the same page, alternative text and how the picture fits its box
("contain", "cover" or "stretch").

raster.description: Raster is true when a PNG copy exists (always for raster images, for an SVG only after the browser sent one).

branch.description:

request's own branch query parameter said otherwise.

mask_sensitive.description: MaskSensitive replaces the values of sensitive headers (request and response) with "***".

endpoint_method.description:
EndpointMethod/EndpointPath identify the documented endpoint (as in the navigation); HTTPMethod is
the method actually sent (always POST for JSON-RPC and GraphQL).

body_file.description: BodyFile names the sibling file holding a large body; it is only set inside response-N.json.

enabled.description: Enabled turns the hourly check against the license server on or off.

token.description: Token is the renewal token created on the license server. Omitted or empty keeps the saved token.

last_check_at.description: LastCheckAt is the time of the last request to the license server since the start of the process.

last_error.description: LastError is the failure of the last check; empty when it succeeded.

last_result.description: LastResult is one of created, updated, up_to_date and not_changed; empty until a check succeeded.

token_set.description: TokenSet tells whether a token is saved.

license_id.description:
The parameters the license was issued with, exactly as stored in the file (absent while no license
content is known). A v1 license reports the unlimited tier and every feature.

can_admin.description:
CanAdmin is true only for a request carrying a valid admin session's bearer token - false for
an anonymous request or a valid non-admin session, never an error either way (an anonymous
visitor is a perfectly normal caller of this endpoint, not a failure case).

license_id.description:
The parameters the license was issued with, exactly as stored in the file (absent while no license
content is known). A v1 license reports the unlimited tier and every feature.

usage.description:
Usage and QuotaUsage are the current consumption against Limits and Quotas. They are filled only for a
request carrying a valid session, since they describe the installation's contents.

body.description:
Body is the generated example already pretty-printed as a JSON string, ready to drop
directly into the Try-It Body textarea without any further formatting on the client.

mode.description: Slack: Mode is "bot" (bot token + Channel) or "webhook" (Incoming Webhook URL).

clear_secrets.description: ClearSecrets names secrets to remove (bearer_token, bot_token, webhook_url).

language.description: Language is the UI language code messages of this rule are written in; empty means the default language.
Language is the UI language code messages of this rule are written in; empty means the default language.

style_name.description: StyleName is the name of the style (empty without one).

style_id.description: StyleID is the style of the site; empty means the default look.

slugs.description: Slugs lists every service of the version once, in the new order.

publish_examples.description:
PublishExamples keeps the request and response examples in the snapshot; they can hold secrets, so the
default is to leave them out.

footer.description: Footer is the footer of the site (task 342).

header.description: Header is the top bar of the site: its height and the row of links.

links.description: Links are where the top and the bottom logo lead to.

header_link_underline.description:
The style of the links of the top bar (header) and of the footer: underline, weight and size in pixels, in the
normal state and when the pointer is over the link (hover).

icon.description: Icon is the name of one of Icons (task 300).

show_in_menu.description: ShowInMenu is false for a group hidden from the left menu (task 287); it still shows on the services page.

show_in_menu.description: ShowInMenu (task 287): absent means shown on create and unchanged on update.

can_unlink.description: CanUnlink is false when this is the user's only way to sign in.

locked_out_logins.description:
LockedOutLogins are users who would be left with no way to sign in: passwordless accounts whose
only identity belongs to this provider.

client_secret_set.description: ClientSecretSet reports whether a secret is stored, so UIs can show "set" without the value.

local_login_enabled.description:
LocalLoginEnabled is false when password sign-in is restricted to admins; the login page then
hides the password form (admins reach it through /login?local=1).

skip_tls_verify.description:
SkipTLSVerify mirrors internal/environment.Environment's field of the same name and JSON tag
- a saved/shared request from before this field existed reads back as false (still verifies
certificates), same reasoning as that type's own doc comment.

breaking.description: Breaking is the verdict of the Change Log on this version of the endpoint.

operation_changes.description: OperationChanges lists the changes of the operation itself - summary, description, deprecation (task 295).

a feature branch name. Versions published before this field existed have it empty - callers
must not read it directly for that reason; treat an empty Branch as the owning service's own
EffectiveMainBranch() instead (internal/versions.Manager's callers apply this fallback, since
the Manager itself has no access to the service registry).

endpoint entirely, or added/removed a request parameter or response field on one that still
exists (task 104) - see changelog.Changelog.Breaking() for the exact rule. False (the zero
value, omitted from JSON) for the first version of a service and for versions published
before this field existed - not recomputed automatically, only by
versions.Manager.RecalculateChangelogs (the same backfill path ChangelogCounts uses).

service (nothing to compare against) or a version published before this field existed.
See internal/changelog for how it and the full Change Log entries are computed and stored.

FormatVersion is the raw value of the document's own root openrpc/openapi/swagger field
(e.g. "1.2.6" or "3.0.3") - the documentation format's version, not the API's own
info.version (that's SpecVersion above). Versions published before this field existed have
it empty - there is no migration, old .meta.json files simply lack the key.

spec_version.description:
SpecVersion is the spec's own info.version, if any. Versions published before this field
existed have it empty - there is no migration, old .meta.json files simply lack the key.

app_version.description:
AppVersion is docs-hub's own release version (internal/version.Version) - shown in the
frontend footer (task 114), always sent regardless of whether User is set, since it isn't
sensitive.

features.description:
Features tells which licensed features are enabled (license.Feature* names); absent when the server does
not report it, in which case the frontend shows everything.

groups.description:
Groups (task 282) are the service groups in display order, each with the slugs of its services in the
group's own order; only the services present in Services are listed and empty groups are left out.

deprecated.description:
Deprecated mirrors the operation's (OpenAPI) or method's (OpenRPC) own "deprecated" field
from the source spec (task 103) - never inferred or defaulted, only ever true when the spec
itself says so.

format.description:
Format is "openapi" for a regular HTTP operation or "openrpc" for an OpenRPC method. Method
and Path are always empty for an "openrpc" entry (an OpenRPC method has neither) rather than
holding an invented placeholder value - callers must branch on Format, not guess from
Method/Path being empty.

has_param_overlay.description:
HasParamOverlay is true when a parameter description of the operation has an overlay (task 239); it does not
make HasOverlay true, which only covers the operation's own description and title.

method_name.description:
MethodName (task 276) is the name of an OpenRPC method as written in its document - what a JSON-RPC request
calls. Name is the identifier, which carries a "@<token>" for a method that shares its name with another.

name.description:
Name is the OpenRPC method's own name as written in its source spec (un-namespaced) - only
set when Format is "openrpc".

icon.description: Icon is the name of the group's icon (task 300).

show_in_menu.description: ShowInMenu is false for a group hidden from the left menu (task 287); the services page still lists it.

href.description: Href is the address of a text page.

pinned.description: Pinned marks an endpoint a person placed by hand (task 308); the structure editor sends it back on save.

branch_count.description:
BranchCount (task 259) is how many distinct branches the service has - filled in next to
VersionCount by loadNavigationDocument (versions.CountBranches); at least 1, the main branch.

current_spec_version.description:
CurrentSpecVersion is the currently published version's info.version (versions.CurrentVersion,
task 141) - not to be confused with VersionCount, which is how many versions exist in history.
Empty when the service has no published version yet, or its VersionMeta.SpecVersion itself is
empty (e.g. GraphQL, which has no info.version - see task 120).

format.description:
Format is the service's domain.Service.SpecFormat ("openapi"/"openrpc"), empty for a
service that has never had a version published (its format isn't determined yet).

main_branch.description:
MainBranch is the service's own EffectiveMainBranch() (tasks 165/167) - always non-empty.
The Versions table filter defaults to it, and breadcrumbs show it in place of PinnedBranch
below when the current session has no active pin for this service.

pinned_branch.description:
PinnedBranch/PinnedVersionSpecVersion (task 167) are set only when the current session has an
active, still-resolvable version pin for this service (see internal/versionpin's package doc)
- both empty otherwise, including for a stale pin whose version_id no longer exists (treated
the same as no pin at all, mirroring merge.ResolveMergedDocument's own soft-degrade). The UI
uses these instead of MainBranch/CurrentSpecVersion in breadcrumbs to reflect what this
session is actually viewing, not the service's global state.

resolved_version_id.description:
ResolvedVersionID/ResolvedBranch/ResolvedSpecVersion (task 179) are the branch/version this
exact response's Endpoints/TagGroups were actually built from - whatever
merge.ResolveNavVersion picked for this service in this request, in its own priority order
(an explicit "version" query parameter naming this slug, then PinnedVersionID above, then the
service's current version). Unlike PinnedBranch/PinnedVersionSpecVersion, these three are set
whenever the service has any version at all, pinned or not - the client uses them (not
MainBranch/CurrentSpecVersion, which describe the service's global default, and not
PinnedBranch, which is empty for most sessions) to keep the page's own URL in sync with what
is actually displayed, including right after a plain load with no "branch"/"version" in the
URL at all (see internal/web/static/app.js's canonicalizeVersionInURL).

tree.description:
Tree is the service's tree in display order (tasks 238, 301): folders, tag groups, endpoints without a tag and
text pages, the service's own saved arrangement or the default one (tags by name, then endpoints without a
tag) when none was saved. TagGroups/their Endpoints are already sorted to match.

version_count.description:
VersionCount is filled in by loadNavigationDocument (versions.CountVersions), not by
BuildNavigation itself - unlike everything else on this struct, it comes from the version
history directory, not the merged spec/overlays BuildNavigation already has in hand.

method.description:
Method and Path are set only for Type == "endpoint" (task 070) - the UI shows them alongside
the title so an endpoint result is identifiable by its URI, not just its (possibly generic)
title.

BearerAuth.description: Session token returned by POST /login, sent as "Bearer <token>".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
